newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Orange's customers growth solid - Hutchison.
newsitem.headline: Orange's customers growth solid - Hutchison.

text.p: Hutchison Whampoa Ltd said on Thursday its British mobile phone associate, Orange Plc, was posting solid growth in its subscriber base which was expected to rise to one million in June.
The growth in Orange was solid and it had about 930,000 customers at the present time, said group managing director Canning Fok following Hutchison's annual general meeting.
"Orange's customers in the United Kingdom should grow to one million next month," Hutchison chairman Li Ka-shing also told reporters after the meeting.
Hutchison has a 49.02 percent stake in Orange, which is listed in London and on NASDAQ in the United States.
Orange occupied about 11 percent of the U.K. cellular telephone market and had a network covering over 92 percent of the U.K. population, Hutchison's annual report said.
